fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zeri''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction. She will dash farther across [[terrain]] if ''Spark Surge'' was cast within 50 units of any, gaining {{tip|unobstructed vision}} of the surrounding 800 units and {{tip|sight|revealing}} herself while there are enemy champions within 1500 units of her.
fields.description2: Afterwards, she gains ''Lightning Rounds'' for 5 seconds, empowering ''{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 100|critScaling=true}}, and pierce through enemies. Targets after the first take modified damage which does not apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects or {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} nor trigger {{tip|on-attack}} effects, but is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
fields.leveling2:
{{st|{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri}} Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|22 to 30}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
{{st|{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri}} Secondary Target Damage|{{ap|80 to 100}}%}}
fields.description3: ''Spark Surge's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds whenever '''Zeri''' hits at least one enemy with a ''{{ai|Basic Attack 2|Zeri|charged}}'' basic attack or ''{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri}}'', increased to {{fd|1.5}} seconds if the latter {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}}.
fields.description4: ''Spark Surge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Zeri's''' basic attack timer and {{ais|Burst Fire|Zeri}} cooldown. {{ai|Ultrashock Laser|Zeri}} and {{ai|Lightning Crash|Zeri}} can be cast during the dash.''

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
